project.name: Hillside Garden House (Metric)
project.description: Synthetic metric companion to hillside-garden-house: the same site and house on a 300 mm module, for comparing the ISO-informed site plan with the NCS-informed one.

exceptions.reason: Entry stays centred on the main rectangular house and its anchored walk, rather than the bounds of the projecting bay.
Daylight opening stays beside the entry; matching the door width would reduce glazing.
Slider stays centred on the main house and opens onto the deck, not the bay-expanded facade centre.
Window must remain in the north bedroom; centring on the full west facade would move it into the great room.

assumptions.statement: This landscape and curved-envelope study omits kitchen and bathroom fit-out, MEP devices and routes, foundations, and bay-roof construction. It is not a complete dwelling or professional handoff.
